value.title: Builder team lifecycle
value.summary: Architecture-enabled team delivery with a separate implementation guide and deterministic workspace-to-archive lifecycle.
value.complexity_breakdown: S=2 I=2 D=2 N=1 F=2 T=2; one cohesive implementation phase with a contracts-first baseline and independent unit waves.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Promote the proven team-delivery method into the harness product: Builder separates product/system planning from a first-class implementation guide; harness builder owns deterministic preparation, readiness, dispatch bookkeeping, composition evidence, review binding, close-out and safe teardown. Architecture creates the independently testable units; the skill applies judgement and existing Builder/eng-harness-flow lifecycles, while the CLI records and checks facts without pretending to judge architecture. This run dogfoods the method manually with an explicit PM, pinned OMP models, isolated worktrees and detailed evidence.

sections.name: goals
value: Preserve all twelve accepted workflow capabilities without creating a second flow or an agent runtime.
Make the implementation guide a first-class, schema-backed team contract separate from requirements and ACs.
Prove both independent unit ownership and an end-to-end observable owner for every acceptance criterion.
Reserve workspace ordinals atomically, preserve allocation ownership and tombstones, and prevent destructive teardown of unpreserved work.
Pin role runtime/model/effort, verify dispatch readiness and acknowledgements, and retain evidence tied to worktree and commit.
Enforce required Builder review/post-flight/archive and engineering-harness receipts through the same lifecycle state.
Ship reusable templates and executable worked examples of architecture-enabled parallel work, including refusal cases.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No new model provider, agent runtime, private pij API dependency, or daemon requirement for portable workspace allocation.
No automatic publication, PR creation, merge, global skill installation, global toolchain upgrade, or silent pij project creation.
No inferred claim that structural validation proves architectural quality or that passing unit tests proves composition.
No migration or rewriting of completed historical plans; preserve their read paths while cutting new authoring over cleanly.
No modifications to Flowspace or pij source trees; their code and reports are prior art only.

value.claim: The packaged CLI exposes the Builder lifecycle through discoverable help and instructions with the existing JSON envelope/exit conventions; missing prerequisites, name collisions and unsupported runtime capabilities are explicit rather than silent success.

New workspace creation atomically reserves the next ordinal against the shared repository and sibling worktrees, records a resumable allocation before Git mutation, never reuses closed reservations, and refuses conflicting or escaping paths without clobbering existing work.

A successful initialization creates the branch, worktree, correctly numbered plan folder, separate implementation-guide source, packet/model-setting templates and complete canonical Builder flow with required harness chores; retries preserve existing content.

Allocation metadata is a deterministic document with explicit owner, worktree, branch, base SHA, ordinal, actor and lifecycle/tombstone state; externally created worktrees are recorded as externally owned and are never silently reallocated or reaped.

The implementation guide has a declared schema and generated Markdown face, with non-empty SRP responsibilities, exact write/read ownership, settled contracts, dependencies/waves, per-unit proof, composition ownership and a justified solo-or-coders decision.

Readiness rejects empty/vacuous guides, unknown or cyclic dependencies, unresolved ownership collisions, missing contract/proof declarations and ACs with no observable capability owner; architectural judgement is reported separately from structural proof.

The contracts stage binds declared shared interfaces, fixtures and required proof to an observed baseline commit/digest, and dispatch refuses changed or absent baseline evidence rather than relying on a status flag.

Repository role defaults and plan/dispatch overrides have documented precedence for harness, model and effort, are recorded with the run, and preserve the distinction between requested launch settings and observed/acknowledged runtime identity.

Dispatch provisions each coder in its own isolated Git checkout (linked worktree or full clone, with kind recorded) at the approved baseline, publishes a scoped packet with resolvable inputs, invokes the declared runtime, records its identity/readiness, and refuses work release until nonce/packet-hash acknowledgement matches the dispatched contract.

Builder stage advancement uses the existing flow state/mutation kernel and refuses unmet DD gates, required harness chores without receipts, missing or stale evidence and unit completion claims outside the declared fence.

The PM composes completed units in dependency order on the plan branch, records the composed SHA and runs the guide-named integration proof against that artifact; conflicts or red proof leave an explicit incomplete state and do not mutate main.

Review records name the composed SHA and exact plan/guide basis; a changed SHA, missing verdict, unresolved material findings or unsupported closure claim prevents review completion, including when unit checks were green.

Close-out verifies required Builder and engineering-harness lifecycle evidence, produces/validates the post-flight record, archives the whole plan folder and re-anchors flow/document references without treating optional shipping as automatically authorized.

Teardown preserves required WIP/reports/observations and a verifiable surviving archive before removal, refuses unowned/dirty/unpushed/unmerged or ambiguous resources by default, is resumable after partial failure and retains allocation tombstones.

Tracked Builder source separates plan and implementation-guide stages and updates registry, routing, templates, tasks/implement/review/post-flight/ship consumers consistently, with capability checks and no second independently advanced flow; completed historical plans retain their existing read path.

The shipped skill/docs include runnable architecture-enabled good and bad decomposition examples, injectable service contracts, dependency waves, AC-to-capability coverage, model settings, packet acknowledgement, composition/review proof and preservation/refusal cases.

The change is demonstrated through deterministic behavior tests and a disposable real-Git CLI lifecycle smoke, independently reviewed with the requested OMP models, and this plan retains the detailed manual dogfood log plus complete lifecycle evidence.

Builder, eng-harness-flow and their templates use the local ddocs CLI and one canonical assets/backpressure.dd.json source to record the actual selected proof approach, link every AC and task assertion to its pressure row, and link observed proof receipts back to the AC; the documented recipe is executed and validated, not merely checked for wording.

After committed composition and independent review, the audited flow-eval machinery runs a blind Markdown-to-PDF extension task using the delivered Builder method and real deterministic documents. Architecture must justify actual independent OMP github-copilot/gpt-6-astra implementation peers, frozen shared contracts, exact packet acknowledgements and isolated roots; the PM composes their commits and an OMP github-copilot/claude-opus-5 high reviewer reviews the composed SHA. The produced PDF, including rendered Mermaid diagrams, must work when independently exercised. Evidence binds the selected new subject plan, baseline, guide, packets, workers, commits, review and output; local ddocs plus the existing complete plan validator establish semantic links. A live native-evidence positive control precedes the run, missing evidence remains unknown rather than fabricated zero activity, and requested/observed/provider identities remain distinct. Preserve the working artifact and complete evaluation evidence outside removable workspaces before owned cleanup. A passing score or a stage-name trace alone does not satisfy this criterion.

value.title: Implement and prove the complete Builder team lifecycle
value.brief: PM contract baseline, then isolated guide/readiness, workspace, dispatch/settings, composition/evidence and skill/document units, followed by PM public composition, real CLI/consumer smoke and independent review.
value.objective: Deliver all accepted capabilities as one cohesive product change, with dependency waves inside this phase rather than unrelated ceremony phases.
delivers: Updated Builder and compatible harness lifecycle routing
Portable workspace lifecycle and preservation proof
Role settings, scoped packets and SHA-bound evidence
Worked templates/examples and complete manual dogfood record
value.key_risks: Preservation at archive/teardown; source-skill/CLI drift; native identity/transport and evidence gaps; complete-plan gate placement after post-flight obligations.

value.title: Prove independent review and complete lifecycle
value.success: The composed feature has actual independent review and complete observed Builder/engineering-harness lifecycle evidence, not only implementation-unit green.
value.notes: PM-owned by the guide composition owner. Executed through the existing review/post-flight/close nodes after implementation; deliberately not in phase-1/tasks so it cannot become its own entry prerequisite. The requested interview follows delivery separately.

value.title: Obtain and record allocator ownership ruling
value.note: Resolved by the prime amendment confirming the already accepted user scope; no additional human approval gate remains.
value.success: Record the allocation authority and creation/adoption/teardown boundary before the shared baseline is sealed.
value.notes: Repository prime withdrew the additional ratification gate: it was not a user requirement. The accepted first-class Builder initialization scope authorizes portable harness-owned creation; adoption records external ownership without re-allocation, and teardown cannot remove resources the allocator did not create. allocation.owner remains explicit. This records the existing authorization and its clarified boundary, not a new human ratification.

value.title: Run blind Builder team delivery evaluation
value.success: A blind subject uses the delivered method for a real Markdown-to-PDF extension with architecture-justified implementation peers, composition, independent review and an independently working PDF artifact.
value.notes: PM-owned final acceptance, after committed feature composition/review and before declaring delivery. Kept outside phase-1 to avoid requiring the final live evaluation before entry to the product review that it consumes. The subject sees the method mandate and task, not rubric, choreography or expected unit boundaries.

tk-0001.assertion: Deterministic behavior and real-Git/packed-consumer smoke results are recorded against the actual composed artifact, with declared test scope and no unobserved green claims.
The requested OMP reviewer has reviewed the committed composition and exact plan/guide basis; material findings are resolved and the model/effort evidence boundary is stated honestly.

The complete Builder and eng-harness-flow close-out has actually run with receipts, a verified surviving archive and preservation-first owned cleanup or explicit safe refusal; optional shipping is never silently authorized.
The detailed manual dogfood log preserves decisions, failures, corrections, runtime/packet controls and final evidence; claims are traceable without relying on this chat.

tk-0002.assertion: The existing accepted scope and clarified allocation boundary are recorded: harness-owned creation, external-only adoption, no teardown of resources it did not create, and explicit allocation.owner metadata.
tk-0002.note: Prime confirmed the former ratification gate was his additional gate and lifted it; manual clone isolation is not used as authorization.

tk-0003.assertion: Before the blind subject starts, the native-evidence adapter passes a live positive control and the fixture records immutable product/package/base/skill inputs; the actual source, coverage gaps and requested-versus-observed runtime settings are preserved without provider-attestation claims.

The evaluation resolves the subject newly created plan explicitly, proves it is not inherited unchanged from the declared baseline, and validates its actual DD pressure, satisfies and proof targets through local ddocs and the canonical complete plan validator.

An architecture review justifies genuine independent implementation units; real OMP Astra peers perform meaningful work in isolated roots after frozen contracts and exact packet acknowledgements. A headcount, file partition or stage-name trace is not evidence of independent implementation.

The blind PM composes the actual worker commits, exercises the integrated extension, and obtains independent OMP Opus 5 high review of the committed composition. Evidence connects guide, packets, peers, roots, commits, proof and review without substituting registry/configuration facts for environment or provider attestation.

The outer PM launches the actual delivered Markdown-to-PDF command on fresh input including Mermaid, verifies a valid working PDF and visually confirms rendered diagrams. A passing score, static sample or the subject report alone is insufficient.

The subject completes the delivered Builder and engineering-harness lifecycle. The working PDF, complete plan/guide/packets, raw permitted evidence, reports and telemetry are verified in a surviving location before ownership-aware teardown; missing proof or unsupported cleanup is named rather than silently declared successful.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Incorporates assets/research-dossier.md (F01-F10 and H01-H04), the accepted intake and the source skills in this repository; the deployed skills and the former external SDD source-location note are stale for this checkout.

value.approach: Hybrid: test-first for state transitions, readiness predicates, allocation/preservation and failure paths; direct behavioral smoke for the public CLI.
value.rationale: The risk is false success or data loss, not syntax; injected fakes prove ordering/refusals and disposable real Git repositories prove the user-facing lifecycle.
value.focus_areas: Non-vacuity; atomic ordinal reservation; path containment; owner checks; stale evidence; contract drift; pending acknowledgements; composition and review SHA binding; required lifecycle receipts; archive preservation and teardown refusal.
value.excluded: No timing thresholds, mocked internal modules, source-text tests as behavioral proof, or live shared-tree validation by concurrent coders.
value.mock_usage: Existing injected port fakes and real isolated fixtures only; no vi.mock/vi.spyOn/monkey-patching.

value.location: Tracked skills/builder and skills/eng-harness-flow source, bundled harness docs/instructions, schema/template examples, and this plan assets directory.
value.rationale: One canonical method and one command surface; examples demonstrate injectable services, good/bad splits, dependency waves, AC ownership and safe closure, while the detailed run log preserves the manual dogfood evidence.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: Assume a local Git repository and installed harness. Portable allocation is harness-owned; adopted resources remain externally owned and cannot be reclaimed by this allocator. Runtime-dependent dispatch diagnoses unsupported capabilities without fabricating readiness. No global tooling or shared-runtime changes occur during a wave. Structural checks and observed receipts stay distinct from independent architectural judgment.

value.question: Ratify portable harness-owned allocation with explicit allocation.owner and no pij allocation dependency?
value.note: Repository prime withdrew the additional ratification gate: it was not a user requirement. The accepted first-class Builder initialization scope authorizes portable harness-owned creation; adoption records external ownership without re-allocation, and teardown cannot remove resources the allocator did not create. allocation.owner remains explicit. This records the existing authorization and its clarified boundary, not a new human ratification.

value.why: Multiple live worktrees and runtime generations make duplicate ownership and partial teardown unsafe.
value.key_questions: Which product owns the reservation; what survives each failed transition; where is the archive proven durable?
value.status: Allocation authority is resolved by the accepted scope and prime amendment; preservation behavior remains subject to independent review and executable proof.

value.question: Scope and workflow mode?
value.answer: User accepted all twelve proposed stages/capabilities and appointed this seat PM; Full mode, one cohesive implementation phase with explicit internal dependency waves.

value.question: Testing and mocks?
value.answer: Repository constitution supplies Hybrid verification with injected fakes and real isolated smoke; no mock/spy replacement of internals.

value.question: Documentation and run evidence?
value.answer: User requires a detailed plan-folder log and worked splitting exemplars in the skill; full Builder and eng-harness-flow lifecycles remain required.

value.question: Runtime and models?
value.answer: OMP github-copilot/gpt-6-astra coders; OMP github-copilot/claude-opus-5 high reviewers; exact selectors verified from OMP catalog.

value.question: Source and integration owner?
value.answer: Prime allocated s098/builder-team-lifecycle; tracked Builder and eng-harness-flow sources are in this repository; PM composes the plan branch, prime coordinates final landing.

value.question: Final delivery acceptance added after the frozen core planning snapshot?
value.answer: Audit the existing Markdown-to-PDF flow-eval scenario/scorer for DD and new-Builder compatibility, then run a genuinely blind evaluation with architecturally justified real implementation-worker fan-out, composition, review and a working PDF. A score or stage-name trace alone is not acceptance; this is ac-0013, a separate delta from core snapshot a58a6c39.

value.question: Does allocator ownership require another human ratification?
value.answer: Repository prime withdrew the additional ratification gate: it was not a user requirement. The accepted first-class Builder initialization scope authorizes portable harness-owned creation; adoption records external ownership without re-allocation, and teardown cannot remove resources the allocator did not create. allocation.owner remains explicit. This records the existing authorization and its clarified boundary, not a new human ratification.

value.effect: Select existing plan/flow/port semantics and preserve the documented isolation, identity and teardown lessons.
Separate guide, reviewed decomposition, shared-contract corrections and final evaluation unit are authored; contract implementation and sealing remain required before coder fan-out.
Harness-owned creation; external-only adoption; no reclamation of resources the allocator did not create. The additional approval gate was explicitly withdrawn.

value.notes: The prime confirmed there was no contrary human ruling and withdrew his extra ratification gate. Allocation follows the accepted first-class Builder scope, with explicit ownership and external-adoption safety.
Services use injected ports/fakes; existing plan/flow substrate is reused; no new agent runtime or unauthorized global/outward action.
Existing entrypoint→act→service→port/adapter layering; PM alone owns composition and registration; frozen interfaces precede workers.
No conflicting accepted ADR identified in the scoped precedent research; ownership ruling is recorded separately.

19 ACs; 8 guide/implementation units, 44 phase assertions, plus 3 plan-level decision/lifecycle/evaluation tasks with 11 assertions. Revised semantic validation and the focused decomposition/evaluation delta review are pending; no product acceptance or sealed baseline is claimed.
Behavioral test-first boundaries and real isolated CLI smoke are planned; final proof is tied to the composed artifact.
Domain mode is off; no separate domain registry work requested.

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: One phase, three architectural waves: PM-reviewed interfaces/schemas/fixtures; five independent guide/workspace/dispatch/lifecycle/skill units; PM-only CLI/package composition and real-Git/consumer proof. Unit tasks satisfy toward the ACs. Composition establishes the product contracts; the full manual-lifecycle AC remains partial until later independent review and close-out, avoiding a temporal gate cycle. Allocator implementation stays blocked until human ratification. After delivery, interview pij-grim-gurgeh and compare the shipped mechanisms with its recent experience.

value.finding: A unit table can cover interfaces yet leave a promised capability unowned.
value.action: Require every AC to name an observable path and responsible unit/composer.

value.finding: An archive inside a deleted worktree is not preserved evidence.
value.action: Verify durable archive/manifests and refuse unsafe teardown before resource deletion.

value.finding: Runtime catalogs and sender identity disagree across legacy and rs tooling.
value.action: Use the actual runtime catalog and explicit supported protocol; distinguish launch request, binding and acknowledged evidence.

value.finding: Builder/eng-harness-flow source and installed copies differ, and backpressure-dd is in flight.
value.action: Edit tracked source only, coordinate the boundary, preserve source-to-generated guards and run the full lifecycle.

value.risk: Confusing creation authority with adopted or manually isolated resources can cause double allocation or unsafe reclamation.
value.mitigation: Use the accepted portable harness allocator for new resources; persist explicit owner/kind/authority metadata, atomic ordinal claims and tombstones. Adoption never grants harness teardown authority.

value.risk: A stale SHA, moved plan path, or fabricated receipt permits false completion.
value.mitigation: Bind evidence to inputs/commit and validate required artifacts, flow chores and review findings before transitions.

value.risk: Teardown removes uncommitted work, ignored dossiers or the only archive copy.
value.mitigation: Preserve first, hash-check manifests, prove a surviving destination, refuse unowned/dirty/unmerged removal by default.

value.risk: Concurrent validation or global tool upgrades contaminate sibling evidence.
value.mitigation: Isolated dependencies/worktrees; no global installs; one final integrated gate and per-unit contract checks after edits settle.

value.risk: New source skill assumes commands before the packaged CLI provides them.
value.mitigation: CLI capability precheck, bundled docs/schema/template checks and real packed-consumer smoke before release.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: No hand-written plan or flow mutations; use ddocs and harness flow writers.
All file-tool and process roots are the assigned worktree; coders get isolated worktrees and explicit read/write fences.
No full validation suites during concurrent mutation; PM integrates and runs the final composite gate after the wave settles.
Coders use OMP Astra 6; reviewers use OMP Opus 5 high; observed runtime identity is retained with each dispatch.
No global skill install or platform repair; notify prime before any governance allocation or integration-boundary change.
Shipping permissions remain explicit; do not erase the worktree while the archived plan and required evidence exist only there.
Preserve all twelve accepted capabilities; new command spellings may be refined only while retaining their behavior and one canonical public surface.

Use node_modules/.bin/ddocs for the actual canonical backpressure/proof/AC link workflow; source-skill wording alone is insufficient proof, and no removed harness dd or Markdown-only alternate is introduced.

After the requested delivery is complete, interview pij-grim-gurgeh about its recent experience and compare concrete failures with the shipped approach, skills and commands; preserve raw/private interview material in scratch and promote only publication-safe findings. The interview is not an implementation-entry prerequisite.
